recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining current-build reference problem tied to the old artifact named by FHIR-28086; any other medication-definition r5-changes typos should be handled by separate audits.
issue_request: FHIR-28086 was a Published FHIR-core BR&R change request resolved as Persuasive for R5. It requested broadening the former MedicinalProductPackaged/PackagedProductDefinition scope beyond medicinal products by adding PackagedProductDefinition.type as a CodeableConcept, expanding PackagedProductDefinition.package.containedItem.item to include BiologicallyDerivedProduct and NutritionProduct, and updating text that limited the resource to medicinal products.
initial_application: The requested model and narrative changes were explicitly applied in d72f0cd65b, which added PackagedProductDefinition.type, broadened descriptions, expanded contained-item resource targets, and added biological/nutrition search parameters. Later source refactors carried the spreadsheet-era changes into the current StructureDefinition XML and search-parameter bundle.
additional_context: The current source lists PackagedProductDefinition as an active BR&R current-build resource and already contains the requested type, package-type terminology, broad contained-item targets, biological/nutrition search parameters, and broadened narrative. Later commits converted contained-item references to CodeableReference and renamed package to packaging, explaining differences from the original Jira wording. BR&R minutes confirm FHIR-28086 approval by 17-0-0. The only remaining current-spec problem found was an active [r5-changes] map entry pointing MedicinalProductPackaged to the non-existent ProductPackagedDefinition name.
reconciliation: Changed source/fhir.ini so MedicinalProductPackaged maps to PackagedProductDefinition instead of ProductPackagedDefinition. No model, terminology, search-parameter, or narrative changes were needed because those surfaces already match the issue decision and later source refactors.
source_changes: source/fhir.ini: corrected the [r5-changes] mapping from MedicinalProductPackaged=-> ProductPackagedDefinition to MedicinalProductPackaged=-> PackagedProductDefinition.

related_jiras.note: Converted relevant package/item references to CodeableReference, explaining why the current source representation differs from the original Reference wording while preserving the target profiles.
